## Walkthrough

This pull request adds GitHub Actions `merge_group` event triggers across 13 workflow files. For five of the simpler workflows, only the trigger is added. For eight vector-related workflows, the PR additionally updates the `concurrency.group` expressions to include `github.event.merge_group.head_ref` as a fallback value, enabling the workflows to run on merge queue events with improved concurrency handling.

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~5 minutes

- Homogeneous, repetitive pattern changes applied consistently across all files
- No logic or functional behavior modifications to workflow steps or jobs
- Configuration-only adjustments to GitHub Actions workflow triggers and concurrency settings

**Areas for attention:**
- Verify that all intended workflows have the `merge_group` trigger added
- Confirm the concurrency group expressions with `merge_group.head_ref` fallback logic are syntactically consistent and appropriate for merge queue operations
